technical.summary: Long-term trend structure is bullish but short-term momentum is weak with price below key moving averages, negative MACD, and no confirmed entry signals; oversold conditions present but lack bullish confirmation.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (372.96) combined with earnings binary event in 3 days creates severe near-term risk; normal yield curve provides minimal offset.
